notes: Phase 4: Image Load Failure Feedback (H-2). Added optional onFailures callback to ImageLibrary.addImages() that fires (failedCount, totalCount) when some images fail to load. Wired through createCollageLifecycle.js (global drop handler) and createFileHandlers.js (file input handler) to show toast notifications. Added try/catch around onFailures invocation per world-review recommendation. 7 new tests covering: callback fires on partial failure, no callback on all-success, no error when callback omitted, all-fail scenario, image-only count, progress coexistence, and callback error isolation. All 1,419 tests pass.
